retrievalProfile.description: A minimalist 1970s-style layout featuring a central isolated photographic subject against a vast white field with stacked, stylistically contrasting typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark white square composition where a small, detailed photograph of a group in a vintage red convertible is centered, anchored by bold, marbled display type and a thin geometric subtitle above it.
coreVisualRelationships: Large-scale negative space surrounding a small central subject
Contrast between organic marbled texture in text and clean white background
Vertical hierarchy with text at the top and image in the center
Color coordination between the red car and the red-toned display type
coreInvariants: Stacked typography at the top third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Small photographic subject centered horizontally and vertically; occupies approximately 15% of the total area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold, textured display text at the top center acts as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down vertical flow from the display title to the subtitle, then resting on the central car image.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extremely high; the white background serves as a structural frame that isolates the content.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-key background with saturated red focal points and muted, naturalistic photographic tones.
paletteRestrictions: Natural skin and metallic car tones

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Ultra-bold geometric sans-serif and thin technical sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses heavy, blocky strokes with tight kerning
Display text features an internal marbled or liquid swirl texture
Subtitle uses thin, monolinear strokes with wide tracking
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the display title are often touching or overlapping
The 'A' in the subtitle may lack a crossbar or use a stylized geometric shape
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme weight contrast: ultra-bold textured display paired with thin, spaced-out technical sans.
graphicDevices: Clipping mask for marbled texture inside lettering
Soft drop shadow under the car to ground it in the white space

preserve: Marbled texture in the main title
avoid: Centered text that is wider than the image below it

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the blocky, geometric 70s display feel
Matches the technical, wide-tracked subtitle style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution image of a vintage 1930s-style red convertible car with passengers, isolated on a pure white background with a soft shadow underneath. Ensure the car is centered and small relative to the canvas.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place the main title in an ultra-bold geometric sans-serif at the top center. Apply a red and white liquid marble texture to the fill. Directly below, place the subtitle in a thin, wide-tracked technical sans-serif in solid black.

verificationChecks: Is the car image centered and relatively small?
Does the top text have a marbled texture?
Is the subtitle tracking significantly wider than the title?

adjustableVariables: Scale of the central photographic island
Vertical spacing between text and image
mustRedesign: Avoid using the specific car model or people from the original
Do not replicate the specific logo at the bottom left

mustAchieve: Seamless isolation of the photographic subject

postGenerationChecks: Check for pure white background without artifacts
Ensure marbled texture is confined to the text
Verify the car is grounded with a subtle shadow
Confirm the subtitle is legible despite wide tracking
recipe.reuseFormula: Isolated central subject + [Ultra-Bold Textured Title] / [Thin Wide-Track Subtitle] + Vast White Space
